name: request_content
description: Hand a brief to the studio, which writes content for the learner on the content model and publishes it through the app's validators: a practice module (drill, quest, challenge), a word pack, a story for the fire, a reading, a scene's happening or a dialog variant, a villager, an arrival, a grammar page, a cheat-sheet card, homework. Use it when the learner asks for new practice or content ("make me exercises for X", "words for the doctor", "a story about the vintage"), when a chat's data asks for a drill (quest_drill, grammar_drill, reading_request), or when a mistake pattern keeps coming back and list_modules has nothing for it. It returns at once: the studio works on its own (the learner sees "✍️ Pišem …" and can cancel it) and tells the learner itself when it's done. Reply in one line that it's on its way; don't write the content yourself. The brief says what to write and why: the mistake patterns' ids, the level, what the learner said they want, what to avoid; the studio reads the learner's state and the guide itself.

title.description: A short name the app shows while it's written, in the learner's languages: "Vaje: rodilnik množine · Genitive plural drill".

brief.description: What to write and why: the kind of content, the mistake pattern ids, the level, the topic, what to avoid.

kinds.description: What it will be, as far as you know.

urgent.description: true (the default): the learner waits for it, it starts now. false: it can wait for the night (through the batch API at half price, or while the phone charges on Wi-Fi).
